title: 92+ ATS Score Resume Template
cardDescription: Create a clean, modern, and professional resume with our LaTeX Resume Template - designed for students, freshers, developers, and job seekers who want a polished resume without spending hours designing from scratch.
shortDescription: Create a clean, modern, and professional resume with our LaTeX Resume Template - designed for students, freshers, developers, and job seekers who want a polished resume without spending hours designing from scratch.
stepDescription:
What's Included?
When you purchase this resume template, you will receive:
1. Editable LaTeX Source Code
Customize your resume by changing your name, contact details, education, skills, projects, work experience, and achievements.
2. Professional Resume Layout
A clean, modern, one-page A4 resume format suitable for internship and job applications.
3. PDF Preview
A sample PDF showing how your final resume can look after customization.
4. Easy Setup Instructions
A simple guide explaining how to open, edit, and compile the LaTeX resume using Overleaf.
5. Dummy Resume Information
The template contains dummy information so you can easily understand where to add your own details.

How to Build Your Resume
Step 1: Choose Your Template
Select the Professional LaTeX Resume Template from our collection.
Step 2: Preview the Design
Check the resume layout, sections, typography, and overall appearance before downloading.
Step 3: Download the Template
Get the editable LaTeX source code and the included setup instructions.
Step 4: Open in Overleaf
Open the template in Overleaf, a free online LaTeX editor.
No complicated software installation is required.
Step 5: Replace Dummy Information
Update the following sections with your own details:
- Name
- Professional title
- Email and phone number
- LinkedIn and GitHub links
- Summary
- Education
- Technical skills
- Work experience
- Projects
- Achievements
Step 6: Customize Your Resume
Edit the content, spacing, and formatting according to your requirements.
Step 7: Compile Your Resume
Click the Recompile button in Overleaf to generate your resume PDF.
Step 8: Download Your Resume
Download your finished PDF and use it for internship applications, placements, and job opportunities.
That's it! Your professional resume is ready.
